versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00337 An RTE_E_DET_WAIT_IN_EXCLUSIVE_AREA (0x04) shall be reported by the RTE when an application has called an Rte_Enter API and subsequently asks the RTE to enter a wait state. This is illegal because it would lock the ECU.
